name: ML Environment QA 15
description: Multiple choice question about ML Environment QA: A machine learning model achieved 95% accuracy in identifying low-turnover catalysts from a material...

examples.input:
A machine learning model achieved 95% accuracy in identifying low-turnover catalysts from a materials database. Why might this model be considered good?

Options:
1. An accuracy of 95% is very high, indicating excellent performance
2. It is a difficult problem, so any performance above 50% is good
3. The model shows excellent generalization to unseen catalyst types
4. It is difficult to say without understanding the class distribution - the model might not be better than random guessing
5. This performance is sufficient for practical screening applications
